北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京气温低体感冷，出门请务必多穿衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cold, remember to bundle up warmly before heading out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感微凉，记得添衣保暖，别着凉了。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels chilly, remember to add layers to stay warm and avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海气温不高，体感偏冷，记得添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels cool, please dress warmly to stay comfortable.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云湿润，早晚温差大，注意保暖别感冒。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is humid, mind the temperature difference between day and night.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳气温舒适，早晚微凉，带件薄外套更佳。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is pleasant, but bring a light jacket for cooler mornings and evenings.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都潮湿微凉，记得保持干燥，避免着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is humid and cool, stay dry and avoid catching a cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾且湿冷，能见度低，出行注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and damp, visibility is low. Drive safely!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安潮湿阴冷，体感 0℃，注意保暖多喝水。

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾湿润，能见度低，外出请注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and humid, visibility is low. Please be careful outdoors.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒大雾，体感-25℃，请务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold and foggy, feels like -25℃. Dress in your warmest layers!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但严寒，体感-18℃，注意保暖防冻伤。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but severely cold, feels like -18℃. Stay warm and prevent frostbite.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，温差大，早晚注意添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, but mind the temperature difference. Add layers for evenings.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天湿润，体感微凉，记得添衣保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and humid, feels a bit cool. Remember to dress warmly.

青岛.name: 青岛

大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and extremely cold, feels like -10℃. Bundle up before going out!
